strings: While {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} adapted well to life with a missing limb, the strain of walking with only three legs has left m_c feeling sore all over. r_c devises a list of exercises that will ease the pain, not helping m_c's mood.
m_c hasn't been sleeping right and feels bruised and tender on the side of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} body where {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} limb used to be.
The muscles in m_c's stump don't seem to understand they aren't connected to anything anymore. m_c purrs gratefully when a Clanmate helps massage them.
